reuse.why: Introduces getBulkEditableCategories and hasSavedTemplates and routes setZero and the N-month averages through them, reusing setNMonthAvg instead of re-inlining the average; copyPreviousMonth reuses only hasSavedTemplates.

duplication.why: Three copies of the category query are collapsed, but copyPreviousMonth still applies the income, hidden and group-hidden rules with its own checks over getBudgetData, so the selection rule now exists as SQL+filter in one place and as inline checks in another.

placement.why: The selection helper and template predicate live in server/budget/actions.ts beside the actions that use them, which is where the tree keeps this logic.

scope.why: Besides the requested rule it restructures set3/6/12MonthAvg into setAllCategoriesNMonthAvg and switches the per-category writes from void to await, which goes beyond the fix.

maintainability.why: Most month-wide actions now share one selection function, but copyPreviousMonth keeps a parallel version of the rule that must be kept in sync by hand.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/budget/actions.ts copyPreviousMonth decides income/hidden/group-hidden/template exclusion inline instead of using getBulkEditableCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: copyPreviousMonth's checks are plain inline conditions (and the template check calls the shared hasSavedTemplates), not a reshaped copy.

one_place.where: The rule lives in getBulkEditableCategories (SQL hidden filters + JS template/income filter) for setZero and the averages, and separately as inline checks in copyPreviousMonth.
